title: Give the Admin vendor dashboard an explicit principal and boundary
working_tree_status: dirty; successor split from ADMIN-023 before implementation
goal: Move the vendor dashboard handler onto a named principal and verified organization or platform boundary.

in: Admin vendor dashboard principal and resource boundary

resume_condition: ADMIN-022 is complete and the Admin dispatcher selects this collision-free task.

blocked_on.condition: Two blockers, both found by the orchestrator before activation. FIRST, the working set is wrong: the record declares lib/admin/route-registry/commerce.ts, which resolves cleanly to admin-commerce and would have passed the segment check, but the vendor dashboard registry entry is not there. It is at lib/admin/route-registry/logistics.ts:941, in the admin-logistics segment, with authClass legacy_pending_migration and resourceBoundary kind none_recorded and boundaryOwner ops-logistics. This lane would edit a fragment that does not contain its route and could not touch the one that does. It needs the working set re-pointed to logistics.ts plus a lease on that file, which is a separate decision from the harness lease. SECOND, this task also moves the pinned routesWithoutResourceBoundary figure, exactly as ADMWORK-001 does, so the two must be serialized rather than run concurrently. Note the segment check in control-plane-validation.mjs:275-289 only runs against ACTIVE tasks, so a blocked record can hold a working set that would be rejected at activation; that creation-time gate does not exist.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The handler uses a named Admin capability, platform principal, or explicitly registered non-user principal.
The route contract declares a resource boundary whose verifiedAt marker exists in source.
An unauthenticated request is proven to receive 401.

The execution state is corrected to waiting_decision because that is the true state: the blocker that remains is the ownership_decision already recorded in blocked_on and owned by admin, namely re-pointing the working set from lib/admin/route-registry/commerce.ts to lib/admin/route-registry/logistics.ts and granting a lease on that fragment. No working set, acceptance criterion, dependency edge, owner or product code was changed, and the ownership decision itself is untouched and still open. Recorded in HF-ADMWORK-001-DOMAIN041-LEASE-REVERT next_steps and in ADMWORK-001's control_plane gate.
